data.name: Sam Adams' Boston: Toast to a Patriot
data.headline: Explore the life and influence of patriot, Samuel Adams, then raise a glass at the Taproom after!
data.description:
Explore the life and influence of patriot Samuel Adams. The Man of the Revolution, Samuel Adams was also a man of contradictions. On this tour, visit historic colonial sites as you learn about Samuel Adams' early business failures, his genius in the run-up to Revolution, his descent into obscurity in the new republic, and why only his enemies called him "Sam."

After this special tour experience, raise a glass and show your support for Boston By Foot! Included in the price of your ticket is the choice between a souvenir Sam Adams tasting glass to take home with you, or a free drink at the Sam Adams Downtown Boston Taproom - first round is on Sam! (Over age 21 I.D. must be presented to the Taproom to redeem alcoholic beverages. Non-alcoholic soda options also available). BBF members receive a discounted ticket price.

This tour is presented in part thanks to the generous support of The Boston Beer Company.

meeting_point.address: Samuel Adams Statue in front of Faneuil Hall Boston, MA US 02109

data.cancellation_notes:
- Please arrive at least 10 minutes early to meet your guide. Late admittance is not guaranteed. 
- Public tours can be rebooked on another available tour, or canceled for full credit as a gift card, with at least 24hrs notice. Customers can conveniently cancel or rebook public tour registrations using the "change booking" and "cancel booking" links in the confirmation and reminder emails. Cancellations less than 24hrs prior to the tour start or no shows cannot be credited.
- Private tours can be canceled up to 4 days before the start for a full refund. Private tour cancellations made within 4 days of the tour date incur a small cancellation fee, though they can be rebooked for no additional fees. Contact us to cancel or rebook a private tour. 
- All tours are held in all weather - rain or shine. Please be prepared for the weather and to walk and stand outdoors on your tour. In case of tour cancellation by Boston By Foot due to extreme weather or unforeseen circumstances, you will be offered a refund or exchange. If groups choose to cancel a tour due to weather, the above policy stands.
